routes.name: Residence without work (passive residence)

routes.name: Residence and work, self-employed
routes.summary: Authorization to live and work in Andorra for your own account. The government approves a yearly quota of self-employed authorizations (a quota of 125 was announced). Requirements not confirmed.

other: Quota is announced by the government. Requirements and fees not confirmed.
